interview.hardest_part: Inferring the non-obvious line rules in later mandatory spine groups, especially 2-2, EX-10, and END, from sparse visual feedback while maintaining an exact drawn path.
interview.likely_failure: Getting stuck on a later spine puzzle after exhausting obvious attempts, or losing progress/time through accidental path submissions and misunderstood rules.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Native save slots and persistent notes across restarts, numbered groups that reveal progress, simple mouse path controls, no per-puzzle timer, and milestone saves.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Screenshot-only observation, opaque abstract puzzle rules, active paths persisting after release with the next click submitting, accidental submissions from drags, long-horizon rule inference, and limited time relative to trial-and-error.
